description: This Java class 'RomChecksum' provides methods for calculating and validating checksums within a byte array, used for firmware or ROM data integrity verification in the RomRaider project.

classes.name: RomChecksum
classes.description: Provides static methods for checksum calculation and validation for ROM data.

methods.name: calculateRomChecksum
methods.description: Calculates checksums for specified regions in the input byte array and updates the array.

methods.name: validateRomChecksum
methods.description: Validates checksums in the input byte array for specified regions, returning status codes.

methods.name: validateChecksum
methods.description: Validates a single checksum region based on start and end addresses and a checksum difference.

methods.name: calculateChecksum
methods.description: Calculates checksum bytes for a specified region in the input byte array.
